title: Order display
intro: Order display is a customer-facing board: orders in progress on one side and ready for pickup on the other. Filters control which statuses and order types appear.

sections.title: Order display layout
steps: Tap Order display in the sidebar.
The top bar holds status and order-type filters.
The main area splits into Preparing (left) and Ready for pickup (right).
sections.caption: Order display with preparing and ready columns.

sections.title: Filters
steps: Status filter is multi-select (defaults to In Progress).
Order type filter limits which service types appear (dine-in, delivery, etc.).
Toggle sidebar shows or hides the left navigation on this screen.
sections.caption: Status and order-type filters.

sections.title: Preparing and ready tiles
sections.intro: Orders move to Ready when kitchen workflow marks them complete. Ready orders may play a celebration when they first appear.
steps: Preparing tiles show orders still being made.
Ready tiles show orders waiting for pickup or runner delivery.
Each tile shows order number and key header details.
sections.caption: Preparing and ready order tile grids.
